insight.headline: Order Tax Recalculation
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated for an unfulfilled order. This change affects the GraphQL Admin API and applies to orders updated after August 31, 2026. The recalculation is automatic and does not require any additional input from the developer.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should be aware of this change when updating orders through the GraphQL Admin API, as it may affect the order's tax calculations. To take advantage of this feature, developers can use the orderUpdate mutation with the new shipping address, and the taxes will be recalculated automatically. However, developers should also ensure that their apps handle any potential errors that may occur during the tax recalculation process. Additionally, developers should review their app's tax calculation logic to ensure it aligns with this new behavior.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate tax calculations for their orders, which can help reduce errors and improve the overall customer experience. This change can also help merchants comply with tax regulations more easily.
insight.why_it_matters: This change matters because it improves the accuracy of tax calculations for orders, which is critical for merchants to comply with tax regulations and avoid potential penalties. It also simplifies the order update process for developers, as they no longer need to manually recalculate taxes when updating the shipping address.

recap.headline: Shopify updates Hydrogen, GraphQL Admin API, and POS UI extensions

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Hydrogen developer preview update adds new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and patch changes to @shopify/cli-hydrogen and @shopify/mini-oxygen. These updates improve the reliability of local debugger connections and add support for IPv4 loopback address.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API and Shopify Functions
themes.detail: New fields are available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities. Additionally, the Customer object in Shopify Functions now includes a createdAt field, and updating an order's shipping address recalculates taxes.

themes.title: POS and Checkout Updates
themes.detail: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API, and merchants can see partner details on collaborator requests. The shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement, supporting passwordless sign-in and automatic sign-in with customer accounts.
